newsitem.title: FINLAND: Benefon falls sharply on profit-warning.
newsitem.headline: Benefon falls sharply on profit-warning.

text.p: Shares in Finnish mobile phones maker Benefon Oy fell sharply in thin trade after the company warned of lower second half operating profits on Tuesday.
At 1340 GMT, Benefon traded at 85.00 markka, down 6.50 markka or more than seven percent after briefly dropping to 81.00 markka. Turnover was modest.
The share had been trading at above 90.00 markka before the profit-warning. @

Benefon said the development of its sales has been slower than expected and that its operating profit for the second half of 1996 would be somewhat lower than the 14.8 million markka of the first half.
